(This is a place where info on playing in Hampstead will be posted, as well as any IC rumors, news, or important weather information is posted)
_ _

(Before entering Hampstead, make sure you read about Hampstead Damnations, and how they affect your character.  Do not forget that while in Hampstead, you gain one level that can remove when you leave: https://www.worldanvil.com/w/tales-from-aracania-roanokerpg/a/hampstead-damnations-article?preview=true?)

(Hampstead's Fog.  If you are told the fog has rolled in, you have 15 minutes {using the time it gets posted as the starting time} to get in a building, or out of Hampstead before having to deal with the consequences.  After that 15 minute period is up, anyone outdoors that the fog comes in contact with within Hampstead will gain one level of long term Damnation, but will be immune to gaining more from the fog until it has vanished.  Also vision is limited to 20 feet in the fog, granting full cover to anything beyond that.  Conversely, sound carries particularly well through the fog, causing disadvantage on stealth checks to move quietly.  The only outdoor part of Hampstead that is fog free is the Airship Port, as it sits at an elevation above the fog, but the base of the hill it rests on will be surrounded.)

(Quartering Act.  Hampstead is the home of the quartering act.  As such, rentable space is limited and costs extra.  In addition, all goods and services are so scarce, they cost an additional 25% more.  Also All silver is to be handed over to the soldiers upon entering.  Anyone found with silver on them within Hampstead will have it confiscated and be fined {10 gp in addition to the silver items lost}.  If the fine isn’t paid, the individual is subject to being jailed.  Lastly anyone out after curfew {from dusk until dawn}, who is discovered by the local Law enforcement without a pass, is subject to a fine {100 gp} or being arrested.  Receiving a legitimate pass is difficult so some people look for NPCs that can provide counterfeit passes.  Generally a single night’s counterfeit pass costs 50 gold, and is a DC 10 investigation for a guard to tell that it is counterfeit {but more expensive passes can look more legitimate and have higher DCs}.)
Rumor on the Street: People are going missing.  Stay Vigilant.
HEADLINE: ```Enemies of the crown are invading your privacy.```

Fliers can be seen being put up throughout Hampstead, as well as within the Gazette
```Enemy of the crown.  Sickly Aarakocra wanted for crimes against the His Majesty, including assaulting members of the army, breaking curfew, endangering the public, including actions that lead to the death of a child.  Suspected of being a plague carrier.  Wanted dead or alive, 1000 gold.```

Under there is a sketch that looks fairly similar to <@!246711433730064384>

Posters depicting <@!150319814836092928>, <@!467139287192829977>, and <@!185916549066915852> are hung up all over Hampstead. There is a 1,000 gp reward for their capture (each), for the crime of treason. Their names are not posted. Any of the three passing through hampstead will have to disguise themselves if they have a hope of not being arrested. (Also, a reminder that your fellow players are your allies, you as players are not permitted to snitch on them for gold.)

next to the other wanted posters, a notice is put up.
```Last night, a pair of our finest soldiers were brutally attacked by a foul sorcerer and stripped of their gear. Any information leading to the apprehension of this terrible person will be handsomely rewarded.```
If you want to have a nice tea time, go visit <#851195612049309766> and enjoy a nice cup with the caretaker. (Info leads to evening’s event)
(Event will be at 6:30 PM with <@!470420431841656833> )

'''The thick, damp, warm fog begins rolling in from the north edge of Hampstead.  People start hurrying along the streets to get indoors.  Within the next 15 minutes, anyone caught outside in Hampstead will come in contact with the fog, and will gain one level of Hampstead Damnation, but become immune to gaining more from the fog until it has rolled out.  Any questions about the fog, and read the pins or ask.'''

Scrawled on various alleywalls is a message carved in uneven handwriting. 
```These ones are favored by the underfolk, those with them will not be harmed by us when traveling below. Jigsaw the tinkerer, Evelyn the Hyena, Seraxa the pale one, Meorys the swift, Finn the talker, Ed the hopping one, Bones the Mysteryman, Secel the horned cleric.```
HEADLINE: ```Studies have shown that people feel safer with soldiers staying with them in their houses.```
```The fog lessens, and the air becomes easier to breathe.  It is (relatively) safe to be outdoors in Hampstead once more.```

```The gas in the sewers has dissipated.  The 8 people that struck a deal with Count Kolro (group 1), may move through and use the sewers to get around Hampstead without fear of Kolro's people interfering.  They may also escort a few friends with them, but they must be there to do so.  You may still encounter other critters down there.```

A redcoat posts a notice, grins, and departs. 
```Loyalists to the crown, Come and show your loyalty in an hour at #crowns-justice-pavillion. Witness the end to life for a scoundrel and the purest expression of the crown's justice.```

A redcoat with a broken arm posts 4 more wanted posters. They offer a reward of 250gp each for the capture/apprehension of Jigsaw, Nolan, Bones, and an Italian fire genasi. None of the posters name those pictured. (If you are on a wanted poster you must disguise yourself or sneak while going through hampstead, even when curfew is not in effect)
Whispers can be overheard about some people manifesting burns on their hands spontaneously.
Howls can be heard echoing throughout Hampstead.
```player note, Only Heore buys essence, so with her MIA still, you cant sell it in Hampstead```
A similar notice to the one in <#852731936349880390> Is posted here.
For the second night in a row, howls can be heard echoing throughout Hampstead.
```The Tax On Hampstead's Magic Today: Whenever a spell is cast using a slot of first level or higher, roll 1d10.  If the roll is equal to or less than the slot used, gain a level of exhaustion.```
Heore is back and buying essence

```The Tax On Hampstead's Magic Today: All magic items of Uncommon or Common quality have all functions suppressed.  Examples: Healing potions won’t heal if consumed, +1 weapons are treated as +0 and non magical, Bags of Holding can’t access their contents.```
```For those who took part in the Werewolf Hunt, Mr. Kern awarded each individual 2 rare fiendish essence, 50 gold pieces, 50 copper pieces, and his favor.```
Lunar Report, We are past the full moon.  It will be about a month before we have another full moon.

HEADLINE:  ```The Loyalist forces are closing on General Washington’s Location.```
```A mysterious creature has been seen rampaging through Hampstead, causing property damage, several patrols of redcoats have been seriously injured by the beast.```
HEADLINE: ```Alexander Hamilton has Publicly Sworn Loyalty to King George```
```9:25 AM, A rainbow can be seen appearing over hampstead, a *menacing* rainbow...```
```9:38 AM, The rainbow persists. Infact it has grown so vibrant that it almost hurts to look at.```
```10:30 AM, the Rainbow has reached a new level of intensity, it is beginning to bend and warp in the sky...```
```10:43 AM, the Rainbow is twisting no longer anchored to the earth, a multicolored rift, forming in space and time, Something... Is... Coming through...```
```10:59 AM, The Rainbow has returned to its original shape, more vibrant and beautiful than before, every color imaginable contained within it...```
```11:44 AM, the Rainbow slowly fades away...```

```Many perished in the fires, though many more were saved... Aper's body has not been found, Mr. Kern survived thanks to Bones heroic aid, but was forced to cut off his own arm to avoid infestation... he'll never swing an axe again... Heore is missing, again.```
if a location has "DESTROYED, Rubble" you can still go there.... but know its destroyed to the foundation
Also, there is no longer quartering, no longer silver tax, the redcoats have no foothold in this borough anymore
```A Dark and ominous cloud has begun to grow over hampstead...```
```The Dark cloud overhead begins to swirl even more ominously, forming patterns that begin to resemble Hieroglyphics...```
```The Cloud splits apart and reforms rhythmically, seemingly responding to some outside effect as it begins to descend over Hampstead...```
```The dark cloud has descended low enough that it can now be seen for what it truly is, tens of thousands of *Unrelated, Locusts.```
```The plague of Locusts has reached the ruined streets, swarming over everything and consuming the ash left over from the fire as they locate an entrance to the Sewers...```

```The great cloud of locusts that appeared out of nowhere remerge from below the surface and begin to ascend back into the sky, a small group, only several hundred or so break off from the greater swarm and begin to fly towards...```

***Thunder rumbles over Hampstead.*** 
*The project*... Is complete.
```The Underfolk are not gone for good, and they shall rise again... below. Under the protection of the Silent Count who dwells beneath.```
